verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy-posture question for a payments platform. The pack has no documentation of retention policies, configurable retention windows, customer data redaction or erasure, or privacy-driven deletion workflows. The only nearby material is generic: the MCP write tool accepts DELETE calls, and Workbench Shell can delete objects in a sandbox. Neither shows control over data retention or deletion, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
